Message:
The Curse should
have been dispelled...
so why has it reawakened?!

Pollen laced with deadly poison
rained down upon the city,
still buzzing with festivities.

In the center of it all stood
Solomon, the acolyte of
the most ancient demon.
He whispered something
to that girl I saved before,
and she began to
lose control once more.

“I’ll go after Solomon.
You take care of
that girl, Guinevere!”

At Elaine’s command,
I nodded and got to work.

The reawakened Curse was
more formidable than before,
consuming the city and
leaving only decay.

If I went in there this time,
I might actually not
make it back out...
Even so...I can’t back down now!

—Somehow, we managed to bring
the girl’s rampage to an end.

But, in trying to dispel the Curse,
which was stronger than before,
the Hero of the Staff
collapsed to the ground...

Thankfully, Elaine returned
in one piece.
Now, we had to help the Hero...
